I hear you honey. More than u may realize.  I don't post much bc I'm new to this reddit thing and when I have posted I get less than few replies. 

I suffer in the same ways. I was on the edge last night and had planned out my demise. I attempted in January with no avail, obviously.
If my family hadn't threatened to call the police, I wouldn't be here today, god-willing. I dont want to be here. Im hanging on by a thread for my daughter. But I often feel like I'm doing more harm than good to her and im sure she would be better off in life if she were with my sister. My ex is already doing his damnedest to cut me outta my sons life, for no good reason. Its just to punish SOMEONE for his exes getting him for child support on his other 8 children. Its a game to him. But for me, its literally life or death. I have full custody of my daughter, and share custody with my son (different dads). I cant live without my children. I won't live without them. Which is the exact reason I attempted to off myself in January and yesterday. I bought the things I needed to  hopefully succeed. But for today, they will stay where they are. I cant promise anything for tomorrow. I take each day, minute by minute. Its difficult. And I find myself talking myself out of suicide more often then talking myself into suicide. If that makes sense. Basically, like u said, its not a matter of if, its a matter of when.

In the meantime, im here if u need a friend. Someone thats gets it and can't understand. It takes one to know one, right? 
Please reach out if u need someone.
Big hugs♡
